title: QA wave R2c: checklist run `surface:build` (5 items) at e4e5c6e3
body:
Part of #9296.
Blocked-by: #9298

Build-surface lane — the smallest round (5 active items via `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs surface:build --json`), and the one most likely to be satisfiable straight from R0's gate output.

Execute via the **`checklist-test` skill** + `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`, in the QA tree from #9298. Where a clause's oracle is `build` or `test` and R0 (#9298) already ran that exact command at this sha, cite R0's captured output as the evidence instead of re-running it — and say in the record that the evidence is R0's, with its timestamp. Where the clause needs a command R0 did not run, run it.

Output: one `qa-run` issue in the RUNNER format (+ `bug` on any clause failure), text only, linked back here and on #9296.
